name: Ambar Protein Industries Limited
about: Ambar Protein Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of edible oils. It purchases, packs, and sells refined cottonseed, ground nut, sunflower, maize, corn, mild mustard, and soybean oil. It sells its products under the Ankur name in Gujarat, India. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
